sanskrit: paryadhāvata śailāṃś ca nadīḥ prasravaṇāni ca vyadīpayat tejasā ca trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
english: He coursed over the mountains, the rivers, and the springs, and with his radiance he set ablaze the three worlds, all that moves and all that is still.

sanskrit: evaṃrūpaḥ sa bhagavān putras te havyavāhana sūryavaiśvānarasamaḥ kāntyā soma ivāparaḥ evam uktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata
english: Of such a form, O bearer of oblations, is that lordly son of yours, equal to the sun and to Vaiśvānara, and in his loveliness like a second moon. Having spoken thus, the goddess vanished then and there.

sanskrit: pāvakaś cāpi tejasvī kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām jagāmeṣṭaṃ tato deśaṃ tadā bhārgavanandana
english: And the radiant Pāvaka too, having accomplished the purpose of the dwellers in heaven, then went to the region he desired, O delight of Bhṛgu's line.

sanskrit: etaiḥ karmaguṇair loke nāmāgneḥ parigīyate hiraṇyaretā iti vai ṛṣibhir vibudhais tathā pṛthivī ca tadā devī khyātā vasumatīti vai
english: For these qualities of his deeds, the name of Agni is sung throughout the world as Hiraṇyaretas, 'he whose seed is gold,' by the seers and by the wise; and the goddess Earth from that time was renowned as Vasumatī, 'she who holds the treasure.'

sanskrit: sa tu garbho mahātejā gāṅgeyaḥ pāvakodbhavaḥ divyaṃ śaravaṇaṃ prāpya vavṛdhe 'dbhutadarśanaḥ
english: But that embryo of mighty splendor, son of Gaṅgā and offspring of Pāvaka, having reached the celestial thicket of reeds, grew up, a wonder to behold.

sanskrit: dadṛśuḥ kṛttikās taṃ tu bālārkasadṛśadyutim jātasnehāś ca taṃ bālaṃ pupuṣuḥ stanyavisravaiḥ
english: The Kṛttikās beheld him, his luster like the newly risen sun, and conceiving tenderness for that child, they nourished him with the flowing of their breasts.

sanskrit: tataḥ sa kārttikeyatvam avāpa paramadyutiḥ skannatvāt skandatāṃ cāpi guhāvāsād guho 'bhavat
english: Thereupon that one of supreme radiance attained the name Kārttikeya; from his having been let fall he gained the name Skanda, and from his dwelling in a hidden place he became Guha.

sanskrit: evaṃ suvarṇam utpannam apatyaṃ jātavedasaḥ tatra jāmbūnadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devānām api bhūṣaṇam
english: Thus did gold come to be, the offspring of Jātavedas; and of it the Jāmbūnada gold is the finest, an ornament even of the gods.

sanskrit: tataḥprabhṛti cāpy etaj jātarūpam udāhṛtam yat suvarṇaṃ sa bhagavān agnir īśaḥ prajāpatiḥ
english: And from that time onward this gold has been called jātarūpa, 'born of his form'; for the gold itself is the lord Agni, the master, the Lord of Creatures.

sanskrit: pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ hi kanakaṃ dvijasattama agnīṣomātmakaṃ caiva jātarūpam udāhṛtam
english: For gold is the purest of all pure things, O best of the twice-born; and jātarūpa is declared to have the very nature of Agni and Soma.

sanskrit: ratnānām uttamaṃ ratnaṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ tathottamam pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam
english: It is the most excellent of jewels, the most excellent of ornaments, the purest of pure things, and the most auspicious of all that is auspicious.

sanskrit: vasiṣṭha uvāca api cedaṃ purā rāma śrutaṃ me brahmadarśanam pitāmahasya yadvṛttaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ
english: Vasiṣṭha said: Moreover, O Rāma, of old I heard this revelation of Brahman, what befell concerning the Grandsire Brahmā, the Supreme Self.

sanskrit: devasya mahatas tāta vāruṇīṃ bibhratas tanum aiśvarye vāruṇe rāma rudrasyeśasya vai prabho
english: My son, of the great god who bore the form of Varuṇa, in the sovereign domain of Varuṇa, O Rāma, in the lordship of Rudra the Ruler, O mighty one—

sanskrit: ājagmur munayaḥ sarve devāś cāgnipurogamāḥ yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi vaṣaṭkāraś ca mūrtimān
english: there came all the sages, and the gods with Agni at their head, and all the members of the sacrifice, and the Vaṣaṭ-call itself embodied.

sanskrit: mūrtimanti ca sāmāni yajūṃṣi ca sahasraśaḥ ṛgvedaś cāgamat tatra padakramavibhūṣitaḥ
english: And the Sāman chants embodied, and the Yajus verses by the thousand, and the Ṛgveda came there, adorned with its word-order and its sequence of recitation.

sanskrit: lakṣaṇāni svarāḥ stobhā niruktaṃ svarabhaktayaḥ oṃkāraś cāvasan netre nigrahapragrahau tathā
english: The marks of grammar, the accents, the chant-syllables, the etymology, and the divisions of tone, and the syllable Oṃ dwelt there, and likewise restraint and free recitation as his two eyes.

sanskrit: vedāś ca sopaniṣado vidyā sāvitry athāpi ca bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca dadhāra bhagavāñ śivaḥ juhvac cātmany athātmānaṃ svayam eva tadā prabho
english: The Vedas with their Upaniṣads, the sacred lore, and the Sāvitrī as well—the past, the present, and the future the lord Śiva upheld, himself then offering the self into the self, O mighty one.

sanskrit: devapatnyaś ca kanyāś ca devānāṃ caiva mātaraḥ ājagmuḥ sahitās tatra tadā bhṛgukulodvaha
english: And the wives of the gods, and the maidens, and the mothers of the gods came there together at that time, O upholder of the line of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit: yajñaṃ paśupateḥ prītā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ svayaṃbhuvas tu tā dṛṣṭvā retaḥ samapatad bhuvi
english: Delighted, they came to the sacrifice of the great-souled Paśupati, of Varuṇa; but when the Self-existent beheld them, his seed fell upon the earth.

sanskrit: tasya śukrasya niṣpandāt pāṃsūn saṃgṛhya bhūmitaḥ prāsyat pūṣā karābhyāṃ vai tasminn eva hutāśane
english: From the spilling of that seed Pūṣan gathered up the dust from the ground and cast it with both his hands into that very oblation-eating fire.

sanskrit: tatas tasmin saṃpravṛtte satre jvalitapāvake brahmaṇo juhvatas tatra prādurbhāvo babhūva ha
english: Then, when that long sacrificial session was under way with its fire ablaze, as Brahmā was offering oblation, a manifestation came forth there.

sanskrit: skannamātraṃ ca tac chukraṃ sruveṇa pratigṛhya saḥ ājyavan mantravac cāpi so 'juhod bhṛgunandana
english: And taking up with the offering-ladle that seed the moment it was shed, he offered it as one offers clarified butter, and with sacred formulas, O delight of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃjanayām āsa bhūtagrāmaṃ sa vīryavān tatas tu tejasas tasmāj jajñe lokeṣu taijasam
english: Thereupon that mighty one brought forth the host of beings; and from that fiery essence there was born in the worlds all that is fiery in nature.

sanskrit: tamasas tāmasā bhāvā vyāpi sattvaṃ tathobhayam saguṇas tejaso nityaṃ tamasy ākāśam eva ca
english: From darkness come the states marked by darkness; goodness too is pervasive, and both alike; the fiery essence is forever endowed with quality, and within darkness lies the ether.

sanskrit: sarvabhūteṣv atha tathā sattvaṃ tejas tathā tamaḥ śukre hute 'gnau tasmiṃs tu prādurāsaṃs trayaḥ prabho
english: And so in all beings there is goodness, fiery energy, and darkness; but when the seed was offered into that fire, three beings came forth, O mighty one.

sanskrit: puruṣā vapuṣā yuktā yuktāḥ prasavajair guṇaiḥ bhṛg ity eva bhṛguḥ pūrvam aṅgārebhyo 'ṅgirābhavat
english: They were men endowed with bodily form, endowed with the qualities arising at their birth: from the very crackling 'bhṛg' came Bhṛgu first, and from the embers came Aṅgiras into being.

sanskrit: aṅgārasaṃśrayāc caiva kavir ity aparo 'bhavat saha jvālābhir utpanno bhṛgus tasmād bhṛguḥ smṛtaḥ
english: And from his dwelling upon the embers another came to be, named Kavi; since Bhṛgu arose together with the flames, he is therefore remembered as Bhṛgu.

sanskrit: marīcibhyo marīcis tu mārīcaḥ kaśyapo hy abhūt aṅgārebhyo 'ṅgirās tāta vālakhilyāḥ śiloccayāt atraivātreti ca vibho jātam atriṃ vadanty api
english: From the rays of light arose Marīci, and from Marīci came Kaśyapa; from the embers came Aṅgiras, my son, and the Vālakhilyas from the heap of stones; and they say, O mighty one, that Atri was born here, and so he is called Atri, 'born just here.'

sanskrit: tathā bhasmavyapohebhyo brahmarṣigaṇasaṃmitāḥ vaikhānasāḥ samutpannās tapaḥśrutaguṇepsavaḥ aśruto 'sya samutpannāv aśvinau rūpasaṃmatau
english: Likewise from the scatterings of ash arose the Vaikhānasas, equal to the host of Brahman-seers, longing for the merits of austerity and sacred learning; and from his unheard-of essence arose the two Aśvins, esteemed for their beauty.

sanskrit: śeṣāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ srotobhyas tasya jajñire ṛṣayo lomakūpebhyaḥ svedāc chando malātmakam
english: The remaining Lords of Creatures were born from his channels; the seers were born from the pores of his skin, and from his sweat came the meters, which have the nature of his impurity.

sanskrit: etasmāt kāraṇād āhur agniṃ sarvās tu devatāḥ ṛṣayaḥ śrutasaṃpannā vedaprāmāṇyadarśanāt
english: For this reason the seers, endowed with sacred learning, declare on the authority of the Vedas that all the deities are Agni.

sanskrit: yāni dārūṇi te māsā niryāsāḥ pakṣasaṃjñitāḥ ahorātrā muhūrtās tu pittaṃ jyotiś ca vāruṇam
english: The kinds of kindling-wood are his months; the exudations are called his fortnights; the days and nights and moments are his bile, and the light is that of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: raudraṃ lohitam ity āhur lohitāt kanakaṃ smṛtam tan maitram iti vijñeyaṃ dhūmāc ca vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ
english: The red they call Raudra, Rudra's own; from the red, gold is held to arise; this is to be understood as belonging to Mitra, and from the smoke the Vasus are remembered to spring.

sanskrit: arciṣo yāś ca te rudrās tathādityā mahāprabhāḥ uddiṣṭās te tathāṅgārā ye dhiṣṇyeṣu divi sthitāḥ
english: His flames are the Rudras and likewise the Ādityas of great splendor; and so too are his embers declared to be those that stand upon the fire-altars set in the sky.

sanskrit: ādināthaś ca lokasya tat paraṃ brahma tad dhruvam sarvakāmadam ity āhus tatra havyam udāvahat
english: He is the primeval Lord of the world, that supreme Brahman, that abiding one; they call it the granter of every desire, and there he bore the oblation aloft.

sanskrit: tato 'bravīn mahādevo varuṇaḥ paramātmakaḥ mama satram idaṃ divyam ahaṃ gṛhapatis tv iha
english: Then the great god Varuṇa, the Supreme Self, spoke: 'This celestial sacrificial session is mine, and here I am the householder.'

sanskrit: trīṇi pūrvāṇy apatyāni mama tāni na saṃśayaḥ iti jānīta khagamā mama yajñaphalaṃ hi tat
english: 'Those three first offspring are mine, of that there is no doubt—know this, O sky-goers; for they are the fruit of my sacrifice.'

sanskrit: agnir uvāca madaṅgebhyaḥ prasūtāni madāśrayakṛtāni ca mamaiva tāny apatyāni varuṇo hy avaśātmakaḥ
english: Agni said: Born from my limbs and brought forth by resort to me, those offspring are mine alone; for Varuṇa is one who has lost mastery of himself.

sanskrit: athābravīl lokagurur brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ mamaiva tāny apatyāni mama śukraṃ hutaṃ hi tat
english: Then spoke Brahmā, the teacher of the worlds, the Grandsire of the worlds: 'Those offspring are mine alone, for it was my seed that was offered.'

sanskrit: ahaṃ vaktā ca mantrasya hotā śukrasya caiva ha yasya bījaṃ phalaṃ tasya śukraṃ cet kāraṇaṃ matam
english: 'I am the utterer of the sacred formula and the offerer of the seed; his is the fruit whose seed it is, if the seed be held the cause.'

sanskrit: tato 'bruvan devagaṇāḥ pitāmaham upetya vai kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve śirobhir abhivandya ca
english: Then the hosts of gods, approaching the Grandsire, spoke, all of them with palms joined together and bowing low with their heads in salutation.

sanskrit: vayaṃ ca bhagavan sarve jagac ca sacarācaram tavaiva prasavāḥ sarve tasmād agnir vibhāvasuḥ varuṇaś ceśvaro devo labhatāṃ kāmam īpsitam
english: 'We all, O lord, and the world with all that moves and is still, are entirely your offspring; therefore let Agni Vibhāvasu and the lord god Varuṇa each obtain the desire he longs for.'

sanskrit: nisargād varuṇaś cāpi brahmaṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ jagrāha vai bhṛguṃ pūrvam apatyaṃ sūryavarcasam
english: And Varuṇa, by his nature the lord of the water-creatures, born of Brahmā, took first as his offspring Bhṛgu, who shone with the splendor of the sun.

sanskrit: īśvaro 'ṅgirasaṃ cāgner apatyārthe 'bhyakalpayat pitāmahas tv apatyaṃ vai kaviṃ jagrāha tattvavit
english: The Lord assigned Aṅgiras to Agni for the sake of his offspring; and the Grandsire, knower of the truth, took Kavi for his own offspring.

sanskrit: tadā sa vāruṇaḥ khyāto bhṛguḥ prasavakarmakṛt āgneyas tv aṅgirāḥ śrīmān kavir brāhmo mahāyaśāḥ bhārgavāṅgirasau loke lokasaṃtānalakṣaṇau
english: Thus Bhṛgu was renowned as Varuṇa's, a doer of the work of begetting; the glorious Aṅgiras as Agni's; and Kavi, of great renown, as Brahmā's. The lines of Bhṛgu and of Aṅgiras in the world bear the mark of the world's continuance.

sanskrit: ete vipravarāḥ sarve prajānāṃ patayas trayaḥ sarvaṃ saṃtānam eteṣām idam ity upadhāraya
english: These three are all foremost among the twice-born, Lords of Creatures; understand that all this lineage is theirs.

sanskrit: bhṛgos tu putrās tatrāsan sapta tulyā bhṛgor guṇaiḥ cyavano vajraśīrṣaś ca śucir aurvas tathaiva ca
english: Bhṛgu had seven sons, equal to Bhṛgu in their qualities: Cyavana and Vajraśīrṣa, and Śuci, and Aurva likewise.

sanskrit: śukro vareṇyaś ca vibhuḥ savanaś ceti sapta te bhārgavā vāruṇāḥ sarve yeṣāṃ vaṃśe bhavān api
english: Śukra and Vareṇya the mighty, and Savana—these are the seven, all Bhārgavas, all of Varuṇa's line, in whose lineage you too belong.

sanskrit: aṣṭau cāṅgirasaḥ putrā vāruṇās te 'py udāhṛtāḥ bṛhaspatir utathyaś ca vayasyaḥ śāntir eva ca
english: And Aṅgiras had eight sons; they too are declared to be of Varuṇa's line: Bṛhaspati and Utathya, and Vayasya, and Śānti.

sanskrit: ghoro virūpaḥ saṃvartaḥ sudhanvā cāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ete 'ṣṭāv agnijāḥ sarve jñānaniṣṭhā nirāmayāḥ
english: Ghora, Virūpa, Saṃvarta, and Sudhanvan, remembered as the eighth—these eight, all born of Agni, are devoted to knowledge and free from affliction.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇasya kaveḥ putrā vāruṇās te 'py udāhṛtāḥ aṣṭau prasavajair yuktā guṇair brahmavidaḥ śubhāḥ
english: The sons of Kavi, who is Brahmā's, are also declared to be of Varuṇa's line: eight of them, endowed with the qualities arising at their birth, knowers of Brahman, blessed.

sanskrit: kaviḥ kāvyaś ca viṣṇuś ca buddhimān uśanās tathā bhṛguś ca virajāś caiva kāśī cograś ca dharmavit
english: Kavi and Kāvya and Viṣṇu, and the wise Uśanas likewise, and Bhṛgu, and Virajās, and Kāśi, and Ugra the knower of dharma.

sanskrit: aṣṭau kavisutā hy ete sarvam ebhir jagat tatam prajāpataya ete hi prajānāṃ yair imāḥ prajāḥ
english: These are the eight sons of Kavi; by them the whole world is spread out; for these are Lords of Creatures, by whom these creatures came to be.

sanskrit: evam aṅgirasaś caiva kaveś ca prasavānvayaiḥ bhṛgoś ca bhṛguśārdūla vaṃśajaiḥ satataṃ jagat
english: Thus the world is forever filled by the offspring and descendants of Aṅgiras and of Kavi, and by those born in the line of Bhṛgu, O tiger among Bhṛgu's race.

sanskrit: varuṇaś cādito vipra jagrāha prabhur īśvaraḥ kaviṃ tāta bhṛguṃ caiva tasmāt tau vāruṇau smṛtau
english: And Varuṇa, the mighty Lord, took first, O brāhmaṇa—Kavi, my son, and Bhṛgu as well; therefore those two are remembered as belonging to Varuṇa.

sanskrit: jagrāhāṅgirasaṃ devaḥ śikhī tasmād dhutāśanaḥ tasmād aṅgiraso jñeyāḥ sarva eva tadanvayāḥ
english: The crested god, the oblation-eater, took Aṅgiras; therefore all who are of his line are to be known as descendants of Aṅgiras.

sanskrit: brahmā pitāmahaḥ pūrvaṃ devatābhiḥ prasāditaḥ ime naḥ saṃtariṣyanti prajābhir jagadīśvarāḥ
english: Brahmā the Grandsire was of old propitiated by the deities, who said: 'These lords of the world will carry us across through their progeny.'

sanskrit: sarve prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve cātitapasvinaḥ tvatprasādād imaṃ lokaṃ tārayiṣyanti śāśvatam
english: 'All of them are Lords of Creatures, all of them are surpassing ascetics; by your grace they will carry this everlasting world across.'

sanskrit: tathaiva vaṃśakartāras tava tejovivardhanāḥ bhaveyur vedaviduṣaḥ sarve vākpatayas tathā
english: 'And likewise may they be founders of lineages, enhancers of your splendor, all knowers of the Veda, and masters of speech.'

sanskrit: devapakṣadharāḥ saumyāḥ prājāpatyā maharṣayaḥ āpnuvanti tapaś caiva brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tathā
english: 'Holding to the side of the gods, gentle, sprung from the Lord of Creatures, these great seers attain austerity and the highest practice of chastity.'

sanskrit: sarve hi vayam ete ca tavaiva prasavaḥ prabho devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tvaṃ hi kartā pitāmaha
english: 'For all of us, and these too, are your offspring alone, O lord; for you are the maker of the gods and of the brāhmaṇas, O Grandsire.'

sanskrit: marīcim āditaḥ kṛtvā sarve caivātha bhārgavāḥ apatyānīti saṃprekṣya kṣamayāma pitāmaha
english: 'Setting Marīci at the head, and all the Bhārgavas too—regarding them as our offspring, we ask your pardon, O Grandsire.'

sanskrit: te tv anenaiva rūpeṇa prajaniṣyanti vai prajāḥ sthāpayiṣyanti cātmānaṃ yugādinidhane tathā
english: 'In this very form they will beget creatures, and will establish themselves anew at the beginning and the end of each age.'

sanskrit: evam etat purā vṛttaṃ tasya yajñe mahātmanaḥ devaśreṣṭhasya lokādau vāruṇīṃ bibhratas tanum
english: Thus did this come to pass of old at the sacrifice of that great-souled one, the best of the gods, at the world's beginning, as he bore the form of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: agnir brahmā paśupatiḥ śarvo rudraḥ prajāpatiḥ agner apatyam etad vai suvarṇam iti dhāraṇā
english: Agni, Brahmā, Paśupati, Śarva, Rudra, the Lord of Creatures—this is the settled tradition: that gold is indeed the offspring of Agni.

sanskrit: agnyabhāve ca kurvanti vahnisthāneṣu kāñcanam jāmadagnya pramāṇajñā vedaśrutinidarśanāt
english: And in the absence of fire, those who know the authorities place gold in the stead of fire upon the altars, O son of Jamadagni, on the showing of the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit: kuśastambe juhoty agniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra saṃsthitam hute prītikarīm ṛddhiṃ bhagavāṃs tatra manyate
english: One offers oblation to the fire in a tuft of kuśa grass, with gold set there; and when the oblation is made, the Lord deems delight-giving prosperity to abide therein.

sanskrit: tasmād agniparāḥ sarvā devatā iti śuśruma brahmaṇo hi prasūto 'gnir agner api ca kāñcanam
english: Therefore we have heard that all the deities have Agni as their highest; for Agni was brought forth from Brahmā, and from Agni in turn came gold.

sanskrit: tasmād ye vai prayacchanti suvarṇaṃ dharmadarśinaḥ devatās te prayacchanti samastā iti naḥ śrutam
english: Therefore those who, beholding dharma, give gold—they give all the deities together: so have we heard.

sanskrit: tasya cātamaso lokā gacchataḥ paramāṃ gatim svarloke rājarājyena so 'bhiṣicyeta bhārgava
english: And for him, free of darkness, going to the supreme goal, there are worlds; in the world of heaven he would be consecrated to the kingship over kings, O Bhārgava.

sanskrit: ādityodayane prāpte vidhimantrapuraskṛtam dadāti kāñcanaṃ yo vai duḥsvapnaṃ pratihanti saḥ
english: He who, when the rising of the sun has come, gives gold accompanied by rite and sacred formula—he wards off the evil dream.

sanskrit: dadāty uditamātre yas tasya pāpmā vidhūyate madhyāhne dadato rukmaṃ hanti pāpam anāgatam
english: He who gives the moment the sun has risen, his evil is shaken off; for one who gives gold at midday, it destroys the evil that is yet to come.

sanskrit: dadāti paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ yaḥ suvarṇaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ brahmavāyvagnisomānāṃ sālokyam upayāti saḥ
english: He of steadfast vow who gives gold at the evening twilight attains to dwelling in the same world as Brahmā, Vāyu, Agni, and Soma.

sanskrit: sendreṣu caiva lokeṣu pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpnute śubhām iha loke yaśaḥ prāpya śāntapāpmā pramodate
english: And in the worlds where Indra dwells he gains a blessed standing; having won renown in this world, his evil stilled, he rejoices.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃpadyate 'nyeṣu lokeṣv apratimaḥ sadā anāvṛtagatiś caiva kāmacārī bhavaty uta
english: Thereafter he comes to be peerless forever in the other worlds; his movement is unobstructed, and he becomes one who goes wherever he wills.

sanskrit: na ca kṣarati tebhyaḥ sa śaśvac caivāpnute mahat suvarṇam akṣayaṃ dattvā lokān āpnoti puṣkalān
english: And he does not fall away from those worlds, but enjoys the great reward forever; having given imperishable gold, he attains the most abundant worlds.

sanskrit: yas tu saṃjanayitvāgnim ādityodayanaṃ prati dadyād vai vratam uddiśya sarvān kāmān samaśnute
english: But he who, having kindled the fire toward the rising of the sun, should give with a vow in view—he attains all his desires.

sanskrit: agnir ity eva tat prāhuḥ pradānaṃ vai sukhāvaham yatheṣṭaguṇasaṃpannaṃ pravartakam iti smṛtam
english: That gift they call Agni himself, the bringer of happiness; endowed with whatever excellence is desired, it is remembered as setting all good things in motion.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca ity uktaḥ sa vasiṣṭhena jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān dadau suvarṇaṃ viprebhyo vyamucyata ca kilbiṣāt
english: Bhīṣma said: Thus addressed by Vasiṣṭha, the valorous son of Jamadagni gave gold to the brāhmaṇas and was released from his sin.

sanskrit: etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ suvarṇasya mahīpate pradānasya phalaṃ caiva janma cāgnyam anuttamam
english: All this have I declared to you, O lord of the earth—the fruit of the giving of gold, and its peerless origin from Agni.
